name: vota-v2
description: Sistema de Votação da Melhor Fantasia - Colégio Carbonell (v2)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,magenta" "npm --prefix server run start" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:server && npm run deploy:client
scripts.deploy:server: gcloud run deploy votacao-backend --source ./server --region southamerica-east1 --project vota-v2 --platform managed --allow-unauthenticated --min-instances 1 --max-instances 10 --memory 512Mi --env-vars-file ./server/env.yaml --quiet
scripts.deploy:client: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting --project vota-v2
